common_mistakes.mistake: Leaving PARK before its gate is safely passed, or Pac releases STEADY before Isp crosses the bridge.
common_mistakes.consequence: Leaving PARK before the gate is safely passed can interrupt the route; releasing STEADY while Isp remains on the bridge can let it collapse over lethal slime and cause death/restart. A hero already on an endpoint floor can make a safe retry, but that does not recover a fall into the gap.
